3. Learned counsel representing the Applicant submits for 
the consideration of the bail that despite having been valid 
licence, he was wrongly booked and falsely implicated in the 
present matter, whereas, learned counsel for the Respondent 
refutes to the submissions so advanced by the Applicant’s 
counsel with the primary contention that the shop/firm, so 
claimed, to be non functionary firm which is being shown,
and secondly bills/invoices related to the transaction or the 
offences are not valid, and in support of the same seeks time 
for furnishing few documents.

UKHC010055812026
BA1/560/2026
Rahul Kumar --Applicant
 
Versus
Narcotics Control Bureau --Respondent
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J. 
Mr. M.S. Pal, learned senior counsel assisted 
by Ms. Amreen Bano, learned counsel for the 
applicant.
2. Mr. Shobhit Saharia, learned counsel for the 
NCB.
3. Learned counsel for the NCB pointed out that 
the GST registration of applicant’s firm, namely, 
Jwala Medical Agency was already cancelled suo 
motu on 31.05.2024 as reflected from the GST 
portal, the copy of which he has placed on record, 
and the copy of same is also handed over to Mr. 
M.S. Pal. 
4. In addition to this, it is categorical stand of 
the NCB in the counter affidavit that so-called 
Jwala Medical Agency, which the accused claims to 
be located at Laksar was found non existence upon 
physical verification, and during investigation, the 
premises corresponding to the address mentioned 
on the licence was also visited by the NCB officials
the shop owner- Anantram was also given and 
notice under Section 67 of the NDPS Act, and his
voluntariy statement was also recorded and he 
disclosed that the accused – Rahul Kumar had 
taken the shop on rent in the year 2022, but vacated 
it after only 4 to 5 months.
5. Let Mr. M.S. Pal, may file an additional 
affidavit dealing with the averment as made in the 
counter affidavit as well as the GST cancellation of 
the applicant’s firm, which Mr. Saharia, has  pointed out.
6. Put up this matter on 29.09.2026.
7. In the meantime, Mr. M.S. Pal, may also 
supply the copy of the supplementary affidavit to 
Mr. Saharia, so that he may also go through with it
and then apprised on the next date fixed. 
 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 11.09.2026
Nitesh/
